title: Corporate Data Retention and Fiduciary Governance Standard
source_document: Policy REF-8802 mandates that financial audit trails must be retained for 7 years in immutable WORM storage. Compliance overrides require dual-signoff from Chief Compliance Officer and Lead Auditor within 24 hours. Automated quarterly boundary scans must achieve 100% endpoint coverage with zero unverified exceptions.
